description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notify the amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2070/30 of 10.05.2018
reasoning: This gazette content is a correction notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the name of a Vice Chairman of a Pradeshiya Sabha. It specifically relates to electoral matters and candidate information for local government elections, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves electoral commission decisions and candidate registrations.
